description: Extend InDesign's menus with scripts: list a menu's submenus and items, add a menu item that runs a script file (a script menu action placed in a menu or a new submenu), list the script menu actions, or remove one by title (Application.menus, scriptMenuActions)

menu.description: The top-level menu by name, such as "$ID/Main" (the menu bar) or "$ID/RtMouseText" (a context menu)

scriptPath.description: For add: the script file to run when the item is chosen (.jsx, .js or .jsxbin)

submenus.description: Path of submenu titles under the menu, such as ["Window", "Utilities"] or ["$ID/&Window"]; add creates missing submenus

title.description: For add and remove: the menu item title

name: manage_script_menus
title: Manage Script Menus
